description: Compare a single item between two stores, side by side: whether each has it, every field that differs (entry by entry inside JSON values), and whether the items it points at (products, pages, metaobjects...) exist in the target. Reads only that item where possible, so it is quick. Returns { status (identical, different, only in source, only in target, in neither), changes, refs, notCompared }. Use it for a targeted check instead of diff_stores; take the key from a diff_stores result.

key.description: The item's key, as diff_stores lists it: "size_guide/shirts" (metaobjects), "faq" (pages), "PRODUCT.custom.fabric" (metafield_definitions)...

source.description: Store alias, or "dir:<path>" for a snapshot folder made with export_snapshot.

target.description: Store alias, or "dir:<path>" for a snapshot folder made with export_snapshot.

name: compare_item
title: Compare one item
